claims.content: An alert indicator or force tell alert on a reported line or multi-linked area or range of J7.0 (ACT = 4) messages reporting the force tell alert is set to value 1.

The JO with P' shall terminate a force tell alert by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message terminating the alert for each reference TM which has been used to report the line or area and setting the PT IMD to value 3 in subsequent J3.0 messages.

A JO without P' shall initiate/terminate a force tell alert on a reported line or multi-linked area by sending/receiving the PT IMD in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message for each reference TM which has been used to report the line or area.
Upon receipt, a JO shall clear its own alert or force tell alert on a reported line or multi-linked area by setting/clearing the appropriate SMD IMD or PT IMD in the J3.0 word.
J3.0, J3.4, or J9.5 messages may be cleared by reception of a J9.5 message with the SMD IMD and/or PT IMD set to value 0.
The JO with P' shall initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the PT IMD to value 3 in subsequent J3.0 messages.
All receiving JOs shall accept the alert.

The JO with P' shall terminate a force tell alert by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message terminating the alert indicator with a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message to all JOs. All receiving JOs shall terminate the alert upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J9.5 message with the SMD IMD and/or PT IMD set to value 0.
